1.desc: [Crimson Inscription] max duration extended by 3.5s; when the whole squad triggers [Maim], increases Claret's Crit DMG by 25% for 40s, repeated triggers reset the duration.

2.desc: When Claret is in [Crimson Inscription], or during [Chain Attack: Blood Oath - Resonance], [Ultimate: Blood Oath - Tempered Thousandfold], or [Assist Follow-Up: Blood Oath - Pristine Molten Edge], attacks that hit ignore the target's 15% <color=#2EB6FF>Electric RES</color>; when Claret's attacks hit an enemy and trigger a Sharp Burst, Gash Buildup Rate increases by 15%.

4.desc: During [Basic Attack: Blood Oath·Forge Rank] 3rd skill, the duration of consecutive Slashes can be extended; DMG dealt by [Basic Attack: Blood Oath·Forge Rank] 3rd hit, [Chain Attack: Blood Oath·Blood Pact Resonance], and [Ultimate: Blood Oath·Tempered Through Trials] increases by 20%.

6.desc: When Claret's [Chain Attack: Blood Bloom Oath · Blood Pact Resonance] or [Ultimate: Blood Bloom Oath · Tempered Thousandfold] heavy attack hits an enemy, directly triggers 1 instance of [Maim] DMG.
